title: Relation
description: One rule-derived procedural connection between two nodes of the case graph. A node is a retrieved RIS document (document_id) or a known case without a retrieved RIS document (case_reference_id). Citations between decisions are not relations; they are citation objects (citation.schema.json). Membership in a wider proceeding is derived from the graph, not stored.

relation_type.description: reviews: a VwGH/VfGH decision decides on the remedy against the target BVwG decision; source = higher court. transferred_to: the VfGH transferred the complaint to the VwGH, which decided in the target; source = the VfGH decision or case. same_case: the target is the next later BVwG decision under a shared own case number, the chamber prefix aside; source = the earlier decision.

evidence.description: Verbatim quotes from retrieved documents that support the relation; may come from several documents.

rule.description: Identifier of the rule or procedure that produced the relation.

match_type.description: How the link was established, strongest first. exact_identifier: the evidence states an identifier that names exactly this decision or case (case number with document suffix; the case number of the transferring VfGH decision; a case number shared by two BVwG decisions). identifier_and_date: case number plus a matching decision or pronouncement date. identifier_only: a case number that fits exactly one decision. date_fallback: no identifier in the text; matched on the decision or pronouncement date and the date of the challenged BFA Bescheid; verify manually.

case_reference_id.description: A known case without a retrieved RIS document (e.g. an unpublished VfGH transfer order): case:<court>:<case number as spelled in RIS>. Not a document_id.
